summary: # Apollo MCP Server Tools Reference ## Introspection Tools Apollo MCP Server provides four introspection tools and one explorer tool. All are disabled by default and must be enabled in configuration. Each introspection tool supports an optional `hint` config option for providing custom instructions to the AI agent. ### introspect Explore schema types in detail with configurable depth. **Parameters:** | Parameter | Type | Default | Description | |-----------|------|---------|-------------| | `type` | String | required | Type name to introspect |
